src: A blog is an application of the Internet, in which you write notes to convey news or express ideas, and it works through a content management system, which in its simplest form is a web page on the web on which you see notes (entries) dated and ranked in ascending chronological order from which a specific number is published controlled by the manager or publisher of the blog, as well as the system includes an automatic archive of old entries, each of which has a permanent path that does not change from the moment of publication that allows the reader to return to a particular note later when they are not available on the first page of the blog, as well as ensures the stability of the links and the ability not to delete them.
